description: Crew tensions and 'glitches' were reported by the Commander across multiple days in the final week, attributed to cumulative fatigue, isolation, and end-of-mission pressure (heavy reporting and EVA load simultaneously).
response: The Commander consciously assumed a stronger directive role and prioritised a genuine rest day. Crew morale recovered by the final week.
lesson: Plan a formal rest day at the midpoint of simulation — this is not indulgent. The Commander must monitor and act on morale signals proactively, before tensions escalate. FMARS isolation is more intense and longer than MDRS.
